name: KEEP_LEFT_WHITE_TALL_SKINNY

sa_r2-sa3_arrow.desc: compact block arrow pointing down-left, 81 x 80 on the sign; sheet says only 'A:60'

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R2-SA3 150 x 1150 (1:10 sheet, undated), R25, 5 / 15 (edge 5 + border 10). Letters 80 D stacked one per line, centred: chain 55 / K / 30 / E / 30 / E / 30 / P / 80 (word gap) / L / 30 / E / 30 / F / 30 / T / 60 / arrow 80 / 55 = 1150 -> tops 55, 165, 275, 385, 545, 655, 765, 875; arrow 1015-1095. The arrow ('A:60' on the sheet, pointing down-left) is not dimensioned: traced from the sheet, ink box measured x 34-115, 81 x 80 (sheet at 1:10, so the trace is coarse — 63 px). Only where a back-to-back median is installed or R2-3 signs are frequently struck.
